Available on back-order Availability: Stock models delivered next working day (UK only) for orders placed before 16:30 (Mon - Fri) Facebook Post LinkedIn Pinterest NoiseKen ESS-S3011A Electrostatic Discharge Simulator & GT-30RB Discharge Gun - IEC 61000-4-2 ED 3.0 Compliant quantity Add to basket Add to Request Quote Notify Me When In Stock × Notify Me When In Stock Name Email * Subscribe to newsletter Notify Me SKU: ESS-S3011A + GT-30RB Categories: EMC, ESD Guns & Electrostatic Discharge Simulators Tag: General R&D Brand: NoiseKen Product information Description Standard Accessories Optional Accessories Documentation Specification Reviews (0) Description The NoiseKen ESS-S3011A + GT-30RB is a complete ESD immunity testing system designed for compliance with IEC 61000-4-2 Edition 3.0. This system includes both the ESS-S3011A simulator main unit and the GT-30RB discharge gun, allowing accurate and repeatable contact and air discharge testing straight out of the box. With its intuitive LCD front panel, multi-mode operation, and automated pre-check features, the ESS-S3011A delivers professional-grade performance for R&D, compliance, and production testing environments. *Note, the Probe stand in the product image is a paid-for optional accessory. Key Features Complies with IEC 61000-4-2 Edition 3.0 for electrostatic discharge immunity testing. Multiple operating modes – IEC Standard, Manual, and Sequence modes for flexible test setup. Color LCD display and sloped control panel for improved usability. Automatic CR & discharge cup recognition prevents configuration errors. Pre-check function ensures correct setup before test execution. Discharge detection function confirms valid discharges (air mode only). Optical interface control available for PC remote operation. Infrared remote controller (optional) for convenient remote triggering. Compact, high-reliability design suitable for bench-top or production environments. Short Specifications Output Voltage: 0.2 kV – 30 kV (± polarity) Discharge Modes: Contact / Air Operation Modes: IEC Standard / Manual / Sequence Display: 4.3-inch color LCD with keypad and rotary knob Communication: Optical link (optional interface) Power Supply: AC 100 – 240 V, 50/60 Hz Dimensions: Approx. 280 (W) × 125 (H) × 350 (D) mm Weight: Approx. 6 kg (main unit) What’s Included ESS-S3011A simulator main unit GT-30RB discharge gun (with integrated 150 pF / 330 Ω CR unit) 330 Ω discharge cup (attached) Contact discharge tip (conical) Air discharge tip (round) Gun holder and mounting plate with screws AC power cable Instruction manuals Compliance Standards IEC 61000-4-2 Edition 3.0: Electromagnetic compatibility – Testing and measurement techniques – Electrostatic discharge immunity test. Applications Consumer electronics and industrial equipment – ESD immunity qualification to IEC 61000-4-2. Laboratory and compliance testing – Pre-compliance, certification, and QA validation. Research and product design – Reproducible ESD waveform evaluation. Educational and training environments – Safe, precise ESD demonstration system. Product Images ❮ ❯ Achieve a more reliable test Learn more CR constant indicator Learn more Discharge Detection Function Learn more Infra-red Remote Controller Learn more High visibility LCD Panel Learn more × ❮ ❯ Achieve a more reliable test The new ESD simulator is equipped with 3 pre-check functions; “high voltage power output check”, “insulation failure check”, and “discharge relay operation check” on the main body and discharge gun. You can prevent troubles such as failing to perform the test properly; if you did not notice the failure of the tester body or the relay inside the discharge gun has reached the end of its life. CR constant indicator The constants of the discharge resistance and discharge capacitor, which were previously disassembled and checked, are now displayed on the main unit screen. When the CR unit or discharge cup of the discharge gun is replaced, it is automatically recognized and the type of CR unit is determined. The CR unit and the discharge cup are identified separately, and if the combination complies with the standard, the conforming standard is displayed at the bottom of the main menu. Discharge Detection Function It is possible to check the presence or absence of discharge during an air discharge test, which was difficult until now, by checking the buzzer sound from the tester and the LED display on the top of the discharge gun. Infra-red Remote Controller Since you can operate the tester with the remote control without returning to the tester during the test, the test can proceed smoothly. High visibility LCD Panel Reviewed the past operatability, adding Ten-key and Rotary knob realizing an easier and more comfortable operation. can be realized. In “1 IEC STANDARD” in MAIN MENU, since the test levels are present, the test parameters can be set easily only with selection of the test level. In “2 MANUAL”, voltage, number of times interval and sweep settings of the test can be selected and also the set conditions can be saved. In “3 SEQUENCE”, the set conditions in MANUAL can be recalled for combining them so as to realize the arbitrary sequential tests. In addition, varied functions like setting for gun trigger, automated ESD eliminator, etc. are equipped.
